# ADVISOR

> ADVISOR is an MCP server for the Wayne State app stack. Your coding agent asks it about our standards, supported versions, docs and checks, and it answers read-only from the stack's own files.

Front page: [`site/index.html`](https://nougat.snu.gs/enterprise-apps/advisor/blob/HEAD/site/index.html), a static field map of the stack (open it in a browser).

On Citadel it is served by the raw-PHP deploy layer in [`deploy/`](https://nougat.snu.gs/enterprise-apps/advisor/blob/HEAD/deploy/): a Squire kit whose front controller serves `site/` behind HELMET's security headers. For local development, keep serving `site/` directly.

Checks: `composer ci` (the same command runs on GitLab and GitHub).

Every page below is Markdown. The HTML pages send the same Markdown to a client that asks for `text/markdown`. Written by Squire's agent-ready kit from the README and the pages; do not edit.

## Pages

- [ADVISOR: What applies, and what's next.](https://advisor.apps.wayne.edu/index.md): ADVISOR is an MCP server for the Wayne State app stack. Your coding agent asks it about our standards, supported versions, docs and checks, and it answers read-only from the stack's own files.

## Prompts

- [Get started with ADVISOR](https://advisor.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-get-started): The agent installs ADVISOR, shows you the client config before writing it, and asks its first question once it's connected. The prompt itself is in https://advisor.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
- [ADVISOR in a Laravel app, beside Boost](https://advisor.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-laravel): Uses the laravel/mcp adapter and adds ADVISOR to your client next to Boost, without touching Boost's entry. The prompt itself is in https://advisor.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
